name: Rapac Group Ltd
summary: Rapac Group Ltd engages in the energy, renewable energy, infrastructure, and representation sectors in Israel. The company undertakes the Kalia project, a ground-mounted photovoltaic facility integrated with battery energy storage that has an installed capacity of approximately 15.5 megawatts-peak and a storage capacity of approximately 70 megawatt-hours; and the Ram-On project, a ground-mounted photovoltaic facility integrated with battery energy storage that has an installed capacity of 10.6 megawatts-peak and storage capacity of 27 megawatt-hours.
